summary: Added .gitlab-ci.yml with the nine stages and a real job in every stage except configure (Cloud Run, task 013). Verified in docs.gitlab.com on 2026-10-24: SAST and secret-detection templates (stage test, branch pipelines only by default, so the jobs are moved to secure and given MR rules); workflow:rules with CI_OPEN_MERGE_REQUESTS; release keyword with glab (release-cli is deprecated); docker:24.0.5 dind needs a privileged runner; Kaniko is marked no longer maintained, so Buildah is the package fallback (PACKAGE_BUILDER=buildah); CODEOWNERS compares with the target branch and needs Premium; push rules cannot block edits of existing files; pipeline execution policies need Ultimate. Added scripts/mutation_ci.py so the mutation gate prints NO MANDATORY FILES instead of an empty pass and fails when mandatory files have no engine results. Added a tools Dockerfile. Paper PDF decision: paper_pdf is the cheap git-diff check in govern; paper_build is a manual non-blocking placeholder because no TeX Live image is set up yet. Added scripts/human_only_files.py and the human_only_files govern job as a WEAK backup control (the same MR can edit it away; it enforces nothing on its own). A non-human is decided by the MR author id and the pusher (looked up by username with GET /users?username=...&humans=true because GET /users/:id returns 403 to unauthenticated callers; a user the filter leaves out, or an id in the group variable AFAW_BOT_USER_IDS filled in task 011, is non-human); commit author names only warn. It fails closed when it cannot identify them. The strong control (pipeline execution policy in a separate project, or CODEOWNERS with required approval) is deferred to the FINAL item of PENDING.md. The pipeline needs the test stage declared because the SAST templates require it. AGENTS.md section 17.3 still says these files are guarded by CI; reword it when the paper PDF can be rebuilt. collect_facts for GitLab is stubbed with an explicit notice until task 010. Review round: configure now has a real job (check_configuration runs scripts.check_ci_config: state/config.json against its schema and CI variables by name only), because GitLab hides empty stages. Added scripts/security_gate.py and the security_gate job: the scanner jobs fail only when the scanner breaks, so the gate reads gl-sast-report.json and gl-secret-detection-report.json and blocks on any secret finding and on Critical or High SAST findings; both scanner jobs now have allow_failure false. The SAST report could not be read from outside the pipeline (403), so its findings are reported by security_gate in the job log. Removed the paper_build placeholder that failed on purpose; paper_pdf still requires the PDF when AGENTS.md changes. human_only_files evaluates identity only when a human-only file changed (tests added). The Docker context copies only scripts/, state/schemas/ and state/config.json, and .dockerignore now excludes .env files, keys and tokens. The AGENTS.md section 17.3 overclaim and a TeX Live paper job are listed under task 012 in PENDING.md.
